edge_cases.mitigation: word-budget scripts before generation and enforce cut-words-not-accelerate; protect the pre-payoff pause when trimming

edge_cases.description: A retired format or changed signature is never removed from the bible, so the gate enforces stale canon and correct new posts fail review
edge_cases.trigger: a gate failure traces to a bible entry that no longer reflects creative direction
edge_cases.mitigation: amend the bible with a versioned entry and reason, then re-run the gate; staleness found this way triggers a full bible review pass

edge_cases.description: A strategy document quotes the 85%-muted figure or the Berger & Milkman result as current platform-measured reel statistics, laundering attribution-caveated findings into fact
edge_cases.trigger: an honesty audit of captions, briefs or the bible finds an untagged empirical claim
edge_cases.mitigation: restore the tag (2016 publisher-reported range; 2012 article-sharing study applied by analogy) in the honesty register and correct the document

edge_cases.description: A mid-series grade or totem change is made without an arc reason, visibly fracturing the feed's continuity against its back catalog
edge_cases.trigger: a signature change ships without a versioned bible amendment
edge_cases.mitigation: either revert the change or ratify it with an arc-level justification and a transition plan (e.g. the change lands at a series turn), recorded in the bible

workflow.action: Fix the account-as-story frame and the arc-migration principle
workflow.description: State that only hook/escalation/payoff survive per reel, the monomyth is a series-level skeleton, and arcs live at feed level
workflow.gate: the per-reel survivors and the arc-migrates-up principle are stated with their craft-doctrine tags

workflow.action: Write each persona's want and need with the revelation pacing
workflow.description: One concrete depictable want and one distinct need per persona, with the establish/turn/surface pacing and the shown-choices-not-statements rule
workflow.gate: wants are concrete and distinct, needs are distinct from wants, and the no-captioned-values rule is recorded

workflow.description: Record the Han/Nunes/Dreze grounding and derive the no-loud-logos, texture/cut/setting depiction rules
workflow.gate: the four-group taxonomy and loud-cheaper finding are cited and the depiction rules are explicit

workflow.action: Specify the aloofness device set and close the likeness lane
workflow.description: List the four withholding device families for the original personas and install the reasonable-viewer evocation test with kill-not-adjust handling
workflow.gate: the lane is stated as closed with no workaround guidance and the evocation test covers styling, context and captions

workflow.description: Canonize the five grounded formats with each one's emotional lever and muted-legibility admission check
workflow.gate: all five formats pass the muted test by construction and carry a named lever

workflow.action: Install episodic hooks and assign per-format ending modes
workflow.description: Ground open loops in the information-gap theory, set up the loop ledger with due payoffs, and assign hard-loop vs open-loop per format
workflow.gate: every format has exactly one assigned ending mode and every opened loop has a due payoff entry

workflow.action: Bias format payoffs toward register-safe awe
workflow.description: Apply the Berger & Milkman grounding: payoffs built on environment scale and reveal, never on loud spectacle; flag the article-to-reel analogy
workflow.gate: the study is cited with its controls and the awe-from-environment-not-branding rule is explicit

workflow.action: Design the duo as parallel lives with a crossover cadence
workflow.description: Instantiate distinct-but-rhyming wants, verify solo legibility of each feed, and place scarce crossovers at arc moments with cross-feed teases
workflow.gate: each storyline is legible without the other feed and the crossover cadence is recorded

workflow.action: Write the voice-delivery direction under the phonics flag
workflow.description: Record the wpm anchors and reel band, the downward-resolving pitch register, cut-aligned pauses, and the [UNKNOWN] interpretation flag on all of it
workflow.gate: FACT anchors are separated from ESTIMATE calibration and the phonics flag is carried verbatim

workflow.description: Fix one grade family, location types and totem objects per persona as the named continuity anchors
workflow.gate: the set is small, named, and every planned post can carry it

workflow.action: Compile and version the series bible
workflow.description: Assemble register, formats, ending modes, duo map, voice direction, signatures and the honesty register into the single versioned governance document
workflow.gate: all sections present, every empirical claim tagged, and the change-log discipline is defined

workflow.action: Plot the beat map and run every episode through the go/no-go gate
workflow.description: Sequence posts with arc functions and loop entries, then gate each episode pre-generation and pre-post on the seven checks
workflow.gate: every planned post has an arc function and a completed two-point gate record

dominance_rules.rule: The likeness-lane guard dominates every aloofness and mystery device
dominance_rules.rationale: evoking a specific real person while hiding the face is the operation's highest-severity, least-reversible failure; no mystique gain justifies it
dominance_rules.trigger: any obscured-figure or controlled-reveal concept is proposed
dominance_rules.action: run the reasonable-viewer evocation test; kill flagged concepts outright, never adjust toward deniability

dominance_rules.rule: Silent legibility dominates voiceover and delivery craft
dominance_rules.rationale: the muted majority is the first exposure; pace, pitch and pause only serve the unmuted minority
dominance_rules.trigger: a story beat, script or voice direction is authored
dominance_rules.action: pass the mute test first; assign no plot beat to the voice track alone and caption all spoken content

dominance_rules.rule: The honesty tag dominates any empirical claim, however convenient
dominance_rules.rationale: the 85% figure is a 2016 publisher-reported range, the sharing study is 2012 article data, and craft doctrine is not laboratory fact — upgrading any of them invents evidence
dominance_rules.trigger: an engagement number, study result or platform behavior is cited in the bible, a brief or a caption
dominance_rules.action: carry the grounding file's FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN tag verbatim and refuse untagged citations

dominance_rules.rule: The versioned bible dominates per-post creative impulse
dominance_rules.rationale: genre consistency is the owner's hard requirement and unrecorded drift fractures the feed
dominance_rules.trigger: a draft contradicts the bible's register, formats, signatures or arc pages
dominance_rules.action: fix the draft or amend the bible with a versioned reason — never publish the contradiction as an exception

dominance_rules.rule: The quiet Patrician register dominates awe spectacle when the two collide
dominance_rules.rationale: loud signals read as lower-status parvenu to the in-group audience the operation targets (Han/Nunes/Dreze)
dominance_rules.trigger: a payoff concept needs flash, logos or conspicuous branding to land its awe
dominance_rules.action: re-source the awe from environment scale and reveal; if it cannot be re-sourced, drop the concept

dominance_rules.rule: The need arc's pacing dominates the flex impulse across a cycle
dominance_rules.rationale: a feed of pure want-display produces envy without bonding and plateaus
dominance_rules.trigger: a posting cycle's beat map shows no need-surfacing beats
dominance_rules.action: insert or convert a beat to advance the need through a shown choice before the cycle closes

dominance_rules.rule: The [UNKNOWN] phonics flag dominates any claim about owner voice intent
dominance_rules.rationale: the word is a speech-to-text artifact and the voice-delivery reading is an interpretation, not the owner's confirmed request
dominance_rules.trigger: a deliverable or bible entry describes what the owner asked for regarding voice
dominance_rules.action: carry the interpretation flag verbatim and keep the owner-clarification request live

dominance_rules.rule: An overdue open loop dominates new tease creation
dominance_rules.rationale: unfilled gaps invert the curiosity device into distrust (the information-gap must be fillable and filled)
dominance_rules.trigger: the loop ledger shows a payoff past its due post
dominance_rules.action: pay off or explicitly close the overdue loop before any new open-loop ending ships

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write each persona's want and need before authoring the format library
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-theming every format after the fact because the templates were built around no defined pursuit or value

anti_rework_rules.rule: Lock the quiet-luxury register before any wardrobe, prop or location prompting begins
anti_rework_rules.prevents: regenerating whole asset batches because loud logos and parvenu styling were baked into the first generation pass

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the likeness evocation check at the brief stage, before any obscured-figure asset is generated
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discarding finished videos (or retracting posts) because the concept read as a specific real person after the spend

anti_rework_rules.rule: Assign each format's ending mode in the bible before episodes of that format are edited
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-cutting final seconds post-hoc when a hard loop should have been an open tease or vice versa

anti_rework_rules.rule: Compile the bible before episode one ships, not after a backlog exists
anti_rework_rules.prevents: retroactive continuity patching across published posts that were each internally fine but mutually inconsistent

anti_rework_rules.rule: Word-budget every voiceover script against its duration at the band rate before voice generation
anti_rework_rules.prevents: regenerating voice tracks because the read had to be accelerated past ~170 wpm or hacked down after the fact

anti_rework_rules.rule: Place crossovers on the beat map before either persona's adjacent solo episodes are planned
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reshuffling both feeds' sequences later because a crossover's teases and payoffs had no slots on either side

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record every empirical claim in the honesty register with its tag when it first enters any document
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a later audit pass over every caption, brief and bible page to rediscover which numbers were fact, estimate or unknown

iteration_protocol.action: resolve the [UNKNOWN]: keep or re-scope the voice-delivery group per the clarification, update the bible's verbatim entry, and remove the interpretation flag from deliverables

iteration_protocol.trigger: replay and follow behavior diverge from a format's assigned ending mode
iteration_protocol.action: retune the per-format ending table in the bible and re-cut upcoming episodes of that format

iteration_protocol.trigger: a format underperforms across several consecutive instances
iteration_protocol.action: vary the instance variables inside the shell first; on sustained decay, refresh or retire the format with a versioned bible amendment

iteration_protocol.trigger: a register or signature drift is detected in a feed audit
iteration_protocol.action: regenerate or re-grade offending assets, tighten the bible's register and signature pages, and add the drift pattern to the gate's checks

iteration_protocol.trigger: a crossover episode's cross-feed conversion and sentiment are measured
iteration_protocol.action: adjust the crossover cadence and relational-ambiguity level on the duo map accordingly

iteration_protocol.trigger: audience comments begin naming the persona's value (the need arc is landing)
iteration_protocol.action: advance the arc phase on the beat map: shift from establishing beats toward turn and surface-need beats

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new platform statement or measured figure supersedes a grounded claim (muted rates, hook windows, sharing behavior)
iteration_protocol.action: update the honesty register with the new source and tag, and re-derive any design rule that leaned on the old figure

iteration_protocol.trigger: the gate fails three times for the same reason
iteration_protocol.action: stop issuing exceptions: amend the bible (or explicitly decide not to) and update the gate checklist

priority_rationale: The framing nodes (account-as-narrative-unit, want, need, silent legibility) come first because every device, format and governance rule is read against the beat/arc split and the muted-first-exposure constraint; the persona-device stack (quiet Patrician register, aloofness devices, the closed likeness lane) next because it fixes the register everything is depicted in and closes the one non-negotiable lane before any concept work; the series-format stack (library, open loops, ending modes, awe alignment) then builds the repeatable machinery of the feed; the duo and voice groups instantiate that machinery for two parallel personas and the enhancement-only voice layer under the named phonics [UNKNOWN]; and the bible, signatures, beat map and go/no-go gate come last because they compose every upstream decision into one versioned governance document and a per-episode checklist that keeps the story genre-consistent classic-luxurious.
